title: Mall World exploded
content: Last night I had a vivid nightmare where I was on a higher floor in mall world when suddenly the person next to me says, “It’s going to explode.” A moment later the entire mall blows up, and I fall with flaming shards of the mall all around me until I shake myself awake. Has anyone had a similar dream? I’m curious if I will go back to Mall World in my dreams now.
